- region "Authored study":
  - paragraph: Authored study · Codex gpt-6.1-sol, study author 3 · 2026-11-04
  - heading "Courier at the depot courtyard wall" [level=3]
  - paragraph: "Give the courier a feeler ahead of its travel. A hit supplies more than a warning: the surface normal tells it which way leads back into free space. Put a temporary target along that normal and let the courier pull towards it. The ray can see a wall before the courier’s body reaches it, but detection still needs time to change motion."
  - paragraph: "A courier approaches the end of a depot courtyard wall on the way to an offset delivery point. Watch its forward ray meet the wall and the temporary target turn it towards free space. Then put the delivery straight ahead: the same local rule brakes and switches targets without choosing a side."
  - group:
    - text: The example in full
    - paragraph: The courier starts at (0, 0) with velocity (4, 0) units/s and radius 1. Its delivery point is (18, 15); a vertical wall runs from (10, -6) to (10, 6). A forward ray of length 9 units constructs an avoidance target 6 units along the hit normal. Maximum speed is 4 units/s and acceleration 8 units/s². The run takes 80 fixed steps of 0.1 s. Segment intersection and target selection are study-local; the actual pull to either target calls engine Seek.

      - paragraph: "The long line is the wall. The forward ray runs from the courier to its ray end. On a hit, the normal points back from the surface to the amber avoidance cross. The courier ring is its physical radius. Below the courier, parallel lanes separate velocity above and acceleration below at the same scale as the construction.
